item.description: Everyone is atheist until the plane starts falling. I have no clue who said this.

item.title: Taking Things For Granted
item.author: ahmed@offsechq.com (A.Alghali)
item.description: I’ve taken things for granted before, and I always do. it doesn’t mean I don’t recognize the value of someone or something in my life, it’s just that I’m mostly busy and never able to find time to reflect upon the things I have in my life.
